snippet.title: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
First-person adventure game, playable solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas! Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential. Are you willing to do what it takes to claim a soul of your own?

Developed by: OnSkull Games

Check out the game: https://on.unity.com/PlayAlchemistJourneyoftheSoul
Learn more and submit your project: https://on.unity.com/MWU
Discover more Unity-powered games: https://on.unity.com/MWU-Steam
